text:
sana: Quick proposal — I think we should add a dim-weighted preflight estimate for the embeddings endpoint. Current heuristic (bytes or naive dim count) is causing routing misfires for mixed-dim payloads and bloated quota surprises.

alex: +1 on preflight. two UX asks: show estimate in Console per request and expose it in the response header so SDKs can surface it.

jamie: how do we compute "dim-weighted"? my take: per-vector cost = base + k * dims, where k is tunable per-model. fallback to bytes if dims absent. Keep formula simple for perf.

oliver: telemetry needs: emit `embed.preflight.estimate` with fields: model, tenant_id, request_dims, input_count, estimated_units. also record `embed.actual.units` after serving to compute estimate_error.

marie: quota semantics question — do we enforce vs soft-decline? we should soft-fail (warning + 409 when strict) during canary, otherwise hard rejects will break customers.

sana: agreed. rollout plan: canary estimate-only (no enforcement) for 2 weeks, surface mismatch alerts, then enable soft-cap with opt-in, then hard enforcement later.

alex: sample header for preflight estimate (proposal):
```
X-Embed-Estimate: 42
X-Embed-Estimate-Model: text-embed-1536
```
Also: SDKs should add `embed.estimate` to request/response objects.

jamie: implementation note: runtime needs to compute estimate in ingress (cheap) not post-compile. simple linear model is fine; we can refine offline.

oliver: dashboards — new Grafana panels: "estimate vs actual by tenant", p50/p95 estimate_error, and latency-by-estimate-bucket. paging alert if estimate_error > 25% across 1h.

marie: Console change: add "Estimated units" column to the requests table and a toggle to show "billing estimate". for queries > 1000 vectors collapse UI with hint.

ingest-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout flagged: `embeds.estimates.enabled` -> 10% orgs at 2026-03-22T12:00Z

sana: backcompat: if client sends `X-Dims` header or includes per-vector dims in payload, use that; otherwise infer from bytes (legacy). We need clear SDK migration docs.

alex: open questions: rounding (ceil vs floor), mixed dims in single request (sum of per-vector), and multi-tenant rate limiter interaction. my vote: ceil per-vector then sum.

jamie: action items:
- jamie + oliver: prototype preflight header + telemetry (this week)
- marie: spec Console UX + mocks (end of week)
- alex: update quota docs and public FAQ
- sana: coordinate canary and alerting

sana: ok, everyone's clear? :eyes: :thumbsup:

oliver: 👍 will start proto now.

marie: will ping with design PR later.

jamie: logging note: include `estimate_calc_version` in events so we can iterate without breaking metrics.

sana: thanks all — follow-ups in PRs. :rocket:
